dialogues.speaker: Ohtli
dialogues.text: Careful, next time might be when we find out who the winner really is.

dialogues.speaker: Itotia
dialogues.text: Couldn't look forward to it more.

dialogues.speaker: Itotia
dialogues.text: Let's hope you won't say "What a shame, it's a draw" again. I'm sick of hearing you say that.

dialogues.speaker: Ohtli
dialogues.text: It's not my fault that you can't beat more bad guys than I do.

dialogues.speaker: Itotia
dialogues.text: Allow me to remind you what the meaning of a draw is. It means I could say those words right back at you.

dialogues.speaker: Ohtli
dialogues.text: Then there's no point in fighting like this, is there? Let's just keep working hard, y'know? I mean, as opponents.

dialogues.speaker: Itotia
dialogues.text: What are you talking about? Of course we're opponents. I haven't reached the point where I need to team up with you yet.
